sun.method: NOAA solar equations; sunrise/sunset at zenith 90.833°, civil twilight at 96°

pace_model.beta_note: beta ≥ 0.5 enforced (faster runners less affected, per spec); the splits alone slightly prefer beta = 0

assumptions: Expected runners per course = sources/curated/site.json expectedRunners (default 2026 starters). All counts (on course, aid-station passes, finish crowd) are the 2026-shaped simulation scaled by N / 2026 starters, i.e. the expected value of resampling N runners from the 2026 finish-time distribution. Map dots bootstrap whole 2026 runners (seeded, ±1% time jitter) when N differs, keeping 2026 clustering.
Start: nobody crosses the line before the gun; each runner starts 0-2 min after it (mass-start crossing delay, skewed early: runner quantile u -> 2u² min, faster runners nearer the front).

Start / Finish crowd (one row, same place): every runner (finisher or DNF) arrives 60 min before their own start and stays until the gun; every finisher (all five distances) stays 60 min after their modelled finish; runners passing S/F mid-race (not finishing there) count for 5 min. DNF runners and spectators/crew are not counted. Count = people present at the middle of each 15 min bin.
Finish-time distributions per 2027 distance = 2026 RunSignup results for the identically named event (same start times); one simulated runner per 2026 finisher.

Expected 2027 starters = 2026 starters (finishers + DNF): 2027 registrant counts are not public (RunSignup participants endpoint returns Permission Denied). 2027 caps from RunSignup are shown for reference only.
Pre-2026 years ran 50M / 50K / 30K (plus 10K, 20K) on different courses: used for volume history only, not for times.

Pace along the course: grade-adjusted curve on the 0.25 mi-smoothed profile (see pace_model.params), deviation from flat scaled by fitness (avg pace / 20 min/mi)^beta; fatigue on 100K/55K; climb fatigue 0.2 per 10,000 ft gained; aid-station dwell 4 min base, scaled 0.5× (start) to 1.5× (finish) by race position and halved when the previous visit was < 3 mi earlier; each runner normalised to their real 2026 finish time. Parameters tuned by grid search against 2026 Waterhole timing-mat splits (pace_model.validation).
DNF runners follow the 2026 median finisher pace and stop at the middle aid-station visit of their course.
Start times and station hours/cutoffs from the race sheet (content/); Start times match RunSignup 2027 (race 163892): 100K 5:30a, 55K 7a, 35K 8a, 20K 8:30a, 10K 9a.
